name: rumin_query
description: CRITICAL / PRIMARY CODE NAVIGATION TOOL: MUST be called BEFORE any file reading, grep, or search. Fast associative symbol and context search using Personalized PageRank over AST symbols, call graphs, references, and documentation. Returns precise file paths, line numbers, and architectural context under strict token budgets.

dampen_hubs.description: Apply inverse degree damping to penalize high-centrality hub nodes (e.g. Account, Case)

expand_bodies.description: Include actual AST code snippet slices directly in response

query.description: Natural language query or symbol name

types.description: Optional list of entity types to restrict results to (e.g. 'class', 'function', 'method', 'table')
